# mixedsubjects

`mixedsubjects` is a package for conducting social science experiments
using the Mixed-Subjects Design and estimating causal effects. It
implements seven estimators for average treatment effect (ATE)
estimation in mixed-subjects designs (MSDs), where human subjects data
is augmented with predictions from large language models (LLMs).
Includes Difference-in-Means, GREG, PPI++, Doubly-Tuned,
Difference-in-Predictions (DiP), DiP++, and D-T DiP estimators. Provides
point estimates, variance estimation via delta-method or bootstrap, and
optimal design selection for budget allocation between human
observations and LLM predictions.

## Installation

Interested users can install using:

    # install.packages("remotes")
    remotes::install_github("klintkanopka/mixedsubjects")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bootstrap_variance()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/bootstrap_variance.md)
  : Variance Estimation for Mixed-Subjects Design
- [`compare_variance_methods()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/compare_variance_methods.md)
  : Compare variance estimates across methods
- [`estimate_all()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/estimate_all.md)
  : Estimate all available estimators
- [`msd_data()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_data.md)
  : Data Preparation for Mixed-Subjects Design
- [`msd_dim()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_dim.md)
  : Difference-in-Means Estimator
- [`msd_dip()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_dip.md)
  : DiP (Difference-in-Predictions) Estimator
- [`msd_dip_pp()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_dip_pp.md)
  : DiP++ Estimator
- [`msd_dt()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_dt.md)
  : D-T (Doubly-Tuned) Estimator
- [`msd_dt_dip()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_dt_dip.md)
  : D-T DiP (Doubly-Tuned Difference-in-Predictions) Estimator
- [`msd_greg()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_greg.md)
  : GREG Estimator
- [`msd_ppi()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/msd_ppi.md)
  : PPI++ Estimator
- [`optimal_design()`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/optimal_design.md)
  : Optimal Design for Mixed-Subjects Experiments
- [`print(`*`<msd_data>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/print.msd_data.md)
  : Print method for msd_data
- [`print(`*`<msd_design>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/print.msd_design.md)
  : Print method for msd_design
- [`print(`*`<msd_result>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/print.msd_result.md)
  : Print method for msd_result
- [`print(`*`<msd_summary>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/print.msd_summary.md)
  : Print method for msd_summary
- [`print(`*`<summary.msd_result>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/print.summary.msd_result.md)
  : Print method for summary.msd_result
- [`summary(`*`<msd_design>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/summary.msd_design.md)
  : Summary method for msd_design
- [`summary(`*`<msd_result>`*`)`](http://klintkanopka.com/mixedsubjects/reference/summary.msd_result.md)
  : Summary method for msd_result
